description: Omgevingsverordening- Gelders natuurnetwerk windturbines onder voorwaarden mogelijk is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.gelderland.nl. A zoning plan can allow the construction of a wind turbine for a location within the area referred to as the Gelders nature network wind turbines under conditions possible; and if the compensation for wind turbines and surrounding pavement consists of measures that minimise the adverse effects on the core qualities, surface area or cohesion ... Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Environmental regulation - Gelders nature network wind turbines possible under certain conditions" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2025-03-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
